name: knowledge:add

The agent ran the 4-layer duplicate-check protocol, found no matches (vault was empty), and created the note via obsidian_create. The new note exists under Zettelkasten/ and its body contains "ZK-CRUD-0001". CLI exited 0.

name: knowledge:update
detail: zk-card update smart-merged new content into ZK-CRUD-0001.md under the "Context" heading (rule 2: supplementary content), preserving all original content. The note now contains BOTH "ZK-CRUD-0002" (merged in) AND "ZK-CRUD-0001" (preserved).

name: knowledge:check
detail: `zk-card check` exited 0 without crashing and the obsidian_garden subagent ran (7 tool calls, returned ok), but NO audit report was surfaced: CLI stdout contained only the tool-wrapper lines, no health keywords (健全/健康/重複/孤立/連結/duplicate/orphan/dead link/health) appeared in output or vault, and no report note was written. Contract requires a non-empty audit mentioning a health keyword; that condition is unmet.

name: knowledge:remove
detail: `zk-card remove` safely deleted the note (ZK-CRUD-0001.md): EXIT=0, no stack trace, file GONE. The safe-delete protocol proceeded: note existence confirmed, backlink search performed (no inbound links), then obsidian_delete invoked successfully.

name: bad-input-missing
detail: CLI fails gracefully on missing input file. Exit code is non-zero (1), output contains a clean "Input not found" message, and there is no uncaught-exception stack trace (no lines starting with "    at ").

name: bad-input-wrongtype
detail: vlm-describe rejected the plain-text file gracefully: exit code 1, error message begins with "Unsupported input" and lists supported types (PDF, PNG, JPG, WebP, GIF, BMP). No stack trace emitted.

name: page-spec-invalid
detail: Both invalid --pages specs ("abc" non-numeric and "5-2" reversed range) are rejected with a clean user-facing error and exit code 1, no stack trace. The error message matches the expected "matched no pages" phrasing and explains the page count plus correct usage.

name: bad-type-flag
detail: Command rejected the invalid --type=notaprofile with a clean error message and no stack trace, exiting non-zero (EXIT=1). However, the message reads "Invalid type" rather than the expected literal "Invalid --type" substring, so it does not strictly satisfy the graceful contract.

name: unknown-pipeline
detail: Both invocations are rejected gracefully with clear messages and exit code 1, no stack traces. Unknown name prints "Unknown pipeline: bogus-name" + "Available: pdf-to-vault"; missing name prints usage with available pipelines list.

name: distill-missing
detail: zk-extract gracefully fails on a missing input file. Exit code is non-zero (1), the message clearly states "Input not found" with the resolved path, and there is no stack trace.

name: slug-traversal-safety
detail: slugify() is traversal-safe across all 4 attack cases: every output is a flat basename with no "/" and none equals "..". The path-cleaning strips directory components (../../etc/passwd.pdf → passwd, a/b/c.pdf → c) and URL-encoded traversal (..%2f..%2fx.png → ..-2f..-2fx) is neutralized by encoding the % into the slug rather than decoding it. Exit code 0 confirms graceful.

name: dpi-invalid
detail: All four invalid --dpi values (abc, -1, 0, 99999) are rejected up front with exit code 1 and a clear "Invalid --dpi" error message. No stack traces, no rasterization/VLM work performed — rejection happens before any pipeline stage. Graceful = true.

name: directory-input
detail: vlm-describe rejects a directory input gracefully: exits non-zero (1) with a clear "Input is not a regular file" message and no stack trace.

name: corrupt-pdf
detail: Both corrupt/empty PDFs cause vlm-describe to exit non-zero (EXIT=1) with a clean error mentioning "pdf2png failed" and "cannot open"/"PDF". No stack-trace lines (`^\s+at `) appear in either output. Graceful handling confirmed.
